name: Catalog Source
description: Parse GCAT and McCants catalog editions into canonical CAT records while preserving source-native identities (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only). Each method takes one HttpResponse (HRSP) whose BODY is the complete edition and emits a size-prefixed $CAT record stream plus one FlowNotice (FNTC, Info) report. No capabilities and no hostcalls.

methods.displayName: Read GCAT standard or extended catalog

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request: STATUS 200 (any other status fails the node), BODY a complete GCAT satcat or satcat100k TSV edition, including its header verbatim, bounded to 128 MiB.

inputPorts.description: One fetch response carrying the edition.

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) kind Info: SCHEMA CAT.fbs, SOURCE_NAME gcat, COUNT the records, ITEMS the source-native keys in record order, REASON the diagnostics as ';'-separated key=value pairs (sourceUpdate, unrepresentedDesignators, unrepresentedLaunchDates, unnumberedObjects).

outputPorts.description: Parser diagnostics and source-native keys in record order.

methods.displayName: Read McCants catalog from an element edition

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request: STATUS 200 (any other status fails the node), BODY one complete decompressed classfd.tle or inttles.tle edition (catalog identities only) verbatim, bounded to 128 MiB.

inputPorts.description: One fetch response carrying the edition.

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) kind Info: SCHEMA CAT.fbs, SOURCE_NAME mccants, COUNT the records, ITEMS the source-native keys in record order, REASON the diagnostics as ';'-separated key=value pairs (unnumberedObjects, unrepresentedDesignators).

outputPorts.description: Parser diagnostics and source-native keys in record order.

sequentialJustification.detail: Parse one complete bounded provider edition in input order into canonical CAT frames; the host parallelizes independent editions and this parser does not create threads.
